title: Puerto Galera tourism booms during ASEAN Summit long weekend, records 103% growth
summary: Puerto Galera recorded a surge in tourist arrivals during the long weekend declared for the 49th ASEAN Summit, with visitors flocking to the popular beach destination since Friday.
